'''Magash Drashi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Dathomirian/Legends|Human-Zabrak hybrid]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] who was a [[Witches of Dathomir|witch]] of the [[Singing Mountain Clan]]. In about [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], Drashi and her fellow [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomiri]] adept [[Duala Aidu]] encountered the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jax Pavan]] near Singing Mountain Clan's stronghold, who had ventured to Dathomir to seek the help of the witches.

After challenging the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] as to what his business was on Dathomir, Drashi and Aidu escorted Pavan to the [[Clan mother/Legends|clan mother]] of the Singing Mountain Clan, [[Augwynne Djo]]. The matriarch granted Pavan permission to journey to a ruined [[Star Temple]] that lay within the clan's territory, and, intrigued by the off-worlder, Drashi volunteered to accompany him to the [[temple]]. On their return from the ruin, the witches agreed to help Pavan to access the secrets of [[SD41263.I|the holocron]] of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Ramage]], which would only activate after being provided with a large quantity of [[Blood/Legends|blood]] from a [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-sensitive being, and Drashi, Aidu, Djo, and Pavan all donated blood to allow the Jedi to open the [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]].

Later, after having [[Infiltration of Kantaros Station|confronted]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] using the knowledge of the Sith Holocron, Pavan returned to Dathomir in order to be cleared of his dark knowledge by the witches and to propose an [[Padawan/Legends|apprenticeship]] to Drashi, who had previously showed an open mind about Jedi teachings.
